content: Age' lu dobga ki mi'bǝtl Yesu kal ki Antakiya, mi'nje'shinkǝn ki Lya en ɗa nǝ mi'lashti: Balnabas, nǝ Saminu guni ɗǝ mbetti ki Baki, nǝ Lukiyas ki Kulane, nǝ Manayan gunǝs nal to'ɗi isǝ Guu Hilidus nǝ Shawulu.
Nǝsi natl Lya nǝ ngaptibi ɗaɗanu u, i Yal ki batl ki Lya ki gunti usu, “A'wolinǝn Balnabas nǝ Shawulu gaki kyautǝn u na mbesibi ɗa u.”
Kalki ngaptibi nǝ ngep Lya wasǝn, is zǝsi toh, is pallisi bi.
Shilǝn ki Lya a Kubulus
Si lopi, tǝn shitu wasǝn nǝ Yal ki batl ki Lya shinsi u, is lǝ Salukiya tyaka is tege' kundǝlǝn ki mal is lǝ Kubulus.
Nǝs mbǝkǝci a Salami u, is dlǝmisi shilǝn ki Lya ge'lu lu dobga ki Yahudawa, Yahaya ne'si ti ɗǝtlsi.
Is gadǝl cal gatli hal is mbǝ a Bapusa. A tyaka is mah ne' mul Yahude won mul pǝtl gonti, mul nje'shinkǝn ki lǝgati, mul shin Balyashuwa’
gunǝ isǝ mukaddas Saljiyas Baulus, mul mallǝɓa, it taki ki Balnabas bi isǝ shawulu gaki ti lyap kup shilǝn ki Lya.
Amma Alimas mul idlatl dwaɗǝn u (gu iki shinwasi) in nge' shilǝnwasǝn, in ngayi tǝb bwas mukaddasiyi ɗǝ tǝn la'ti mbadlwasi nǝ Lya.
Iki Shawulu, gunǝ ɗǝ mbettiki Bulus ɗaɗanu u, ki njikǝnǝ, nǝ Yal ki batl ki Lya, i'uti Alimas dwaɗǝn i' usu,
“Ki yakan ki shedan kǝnǝ, mul dutuki, nǝ lǝɓa kizoki! Ka njikǝn i nǝ gǝdl mbalǝn nǝ shiptotugi. Kikǝn za'ti jitti shitu ki Lya waya?
In ngu toh ki Lya ɗǝ leuh mbatl nǝki. Kǝn dǝmti dwa ki lǝpdǝmti, ki kǝn ma'etcitl ki cinwai.” Alǝbi alǝbi i wolkǝnndi nǝ dǝmshal idlati, i'go' ngauti, tǝ mulǝn dǝllit toh.
Nǝmul mukaddasi yen ulnǝ nda u, illa' mbadlǝ, i' kum ngapti bi tǝn shilǝn ki Mulban.
Bulus nǝ Balnabas a Antakiya ki Bisidiya
A te' Basusa, Bulus ne' yelǝnsi wasi is tege' kundǝlǝn ki mali is mbǝkǝci Baliyata ki Bampiliya, alǝbi Yahaya za'si ippal tya Ulshelima.
A te' Baliyata is lǝ tya Bisidiya ge' atl ki Antakiya. Gas cinshu'ti is tege' ludopga ki Yahudawa is dǝm atli.
Kal ki dlǝmissi lashti zhil ki Musa nǝ lwatbat ki mi'nje' shinkǝn ki Lya, mi'kina ki lu dobga ki Yahudawa shin shinkǝn tǝnsi, is usu, “Yelsǝni, in shilǝn nikinɗa ki ndǝlli' mbalǝn mbadlu a' dlǝmini.”
I Bulus hilya i' unisi toh, i' usu kumǝnnǝni, “Kini Yelsǝni Isla'ilawa nǝ kini mi' bǝtl Lya ginǝ bǝ Yahudawa u.
Lya ki mi' Isla'ila i' ol mi'zǝ' mi'zinmini; in nal mbalǝn wasi nǝs dǝm a Masallu; nǝ ndǝtl ki naltwaskǝn tǝ pekkǝlsi ɗǝ ge'atli;
Hwon kutl kutl lǝbi upsi ati ngashtibi nǝsi age' dǝlgǝn;
Itl tlwa mbalǝn gatl ninngi a Kan'ana, ibbǝl mbalǝnwas atlwasǝn ɗǝ gwasǝn.
Musgi akan hwon kutl cen upsi nǝ kutl lǝbi nantam (450). “Kal kigu, i Lya bǝlsi mi'pǝtl shilǝn hal cin ki mbǝ ki Sama ila mul nje'shinkǝn ki Lya.
I mbalǝn ngawi tǝ bǝlsi gunti, Ibbǝlsi Saul yakǝn ki Kish, mulisi ge' bi ki Bilyaminu, ippǝl gunti ki hwon kutl kutl lǝbi upsi.
Kalki tusti Saul taka, ippal Dauda ɗǝ guu wasǝn. I Lya ndǝ'nǝti, i' usu, ‘A mbi Dauda i, yakǝn ki Jessi, mulnǝ ami lyapti ge' mbadli u; tǝn pǝtl mus ulnǝ ami lyamti tǝppǝli u.’
Age' gǝskǝ mulgu Lya mbilli Isla ila mul pekkǝtl si Yesu, kan u nǝ dlǝlli u.
Kapǝn mbǝ' ki Yesu,Yahaya a dlǝmi Isla ilawa sǝ'za'pǝtl bezǝn lǝɓa appǝlisi baptisma muswasǝn.
Nǝ Yahaya ɓal nja ki ngwatlti kyautǝn wasu, i' usu: ‘Wokǝn ki paltǝni? Ami ki gunǝ ki ɓuttǝn uwa. Amma mulǝn ɗa ti mbǝ' ge' kalini gunǝ zhim kaptǝlan wasi akǝn mat tǝngǝltiwai.’
“Kini mil ki Iblahim nǝ na mi'ɓantil Lya age' kini, mini shinimin shinkǝn ki pekkǝltu suɗi.
Mbalǝn ki Ulshelima ne' guumsisi wasǝn saman Yesu wai, ngo'nǝ konnǝtti u is njikǝn dlǝmti ki mi'nje'shinkǝn gunǝ ɗǝ dlipdli huh gas cin shu'tu.
Ko nǝbǝ sa mbiti nǝ bezǝn lǝɓa ki tlotwai u, is ngem Bilatus tǝtl tloti.
Nǝs njikǝn mus ulnǝ lashdli tǝntu, is shitti suɗɗǝ tǝn gǝdlǝnnga is la'ti ge' zuɗi.
Amma i Lya tlǝlti ɗǝge' mǝshti,
Mutti diɓǝli ati ɓǝtl gawasi ma' ginǝ mbǝ ne'ti a Ulshelima te Galili nǝguni siki mi' yenti nǝ dwaɗǝnwasi ma' mbǝlǝn i nǝn.
Mi dlǝmikin zo'shilǝn: Ki ndǝtu nǝ Lya pǝli' mi'zǝ'mi'zinmini u.
Ta njikǝnimini i, mini milwasi, tǝn tlǝtl Yesu lya. Kan unǝ ɗa ki laci u ge' Zabula ki lop:
Lya tlǝlti ge' mi'mǝshti tǝngaki tǝkǝn patl ge' shukǝ ɓostinuwai, Lya usu,

content.text: “ ‘An bǝtlkin albalka kizoki u na pǝli Dauda dlǝliti u.’

content: Tǝn gaki Zabula won a dlǝmini:
Dauda ɓo, i' pǝl ulnǝ Lya pitu age' hwonwasi, in nde yemmbuɗi; i guti ne'mi'ziǝ'mi'zitti i dliwas ɓosi.
Amma gu nǝ Lya tlǝlti ɗǝ ge' mi' mǝshtuwai ta ɓoswai.
“Gaki nugu yelǝnsiyini, ami lyamti ki'manini tu'ma' Yesu dlimi kini pashti bezǝn lǝɓa.
Tu' ma'ti mus mulnǝ ala' mbadlu ta mbi pekǝltu ngu ɗǝge' mus byaslǝɓa, gunǝ bǝ kushti ki Musa taman pekǝtl kiniwai u.
A' yanǝn lu gaki ɓa ulnǝ mi'nje'shinkǝn dlimi u ndanǝ kini.
“ ‘Ya nini, kini mi'mbǝtl lǝɓa.

content.text: Kǝn pǝtl ga gashinti a gǝlni, an pǝtl ulǝn ge' hwonwakǝn gunǝ kǝkkǝn la'ti mbatl nǝ nali wai u, ko tǝ mulǝn dlimi kini.’ ”

content: Nǝki Bulus isǝ Balnabas ɗǝ pe'ti ɗǝge' lu dopga ki Yahudawa u, i mbalǝn mbesi bi sǝmmbil dlǝmisi shilǝn tǝn usi gas cin shuti mul mbǝti.
Nǝ dopga ki mbalǝn zǝgga u, Yahudawa dǝɓǝli ne' mi' ginǝ te'ge' undi bǝlti ki Yahudawa is bǝl ki Bulus kal isǝ Balnabas, sine is pisi shilǝn asi ndǝllisi mbadlǝ sǝcci kina ɗa, ge'alheli ki Lya.
Nǝ cin shuti mbǝ ɗaɗanu u kǝnǝ mus mbalǝn kige' gatli domga tǝngaki sǝ'kum shilǝn ki Lya.
Nǝ Yahudawa en hwu' mbalǝn u, is kum dutugi, is gob nge' ulnǝ Bulus ɗǝ dlǝmti u asi byatlti.
I Bulus isǝ Balnabas is ndǝgisi nǝ ndǝtl ki mbadli: “Kini mi' dlǝmikin shilǝn ki Lya pa. Amma tun nǝ' ka ngeni u, adǝmi ki ɗa lyap mbatl mul lǝshi pa'twai, mǝnpalti tya ma'gini bǝ Yahudawa wai u.
Tǝn gu Lya zimi zhil:

content.text: “ ‘A la'ki, cili ge' mi'ginǝ bǝs man Lya wai u,
gaki ki dǝm shitu mbi pe'kǝtl ki mbǝlǝn ɗa hal pa'ti ki dǝp lǝɓaɗa.

content: Nǝ ginǝ bǝ Yahudawa wai u kumgu u, is kum hwoltugi is nal shilǝn ki Lya; i mus mi'mbi dli unǝ bǝ kǝn mǝshtwai u is la'mbadli.
I shilǝn ki Lya mbǝl lǝllolu' tǝnki mus age' atli.
Amma Yahudawa gob hotti na mudli en mi'ɓantil Lya mi'bas lu kyautǝn ne' mi'kina kige' gatli. Is tlǝl ngashti tǝn Bulus isǝ Balnabas, is katsi ɗǝge' atlwasǝn.
Sine is bǝkǝt kushka ki asǝn wasǝn taka tǝ dǝm dǝtlkǝmɗa tǝnsi is lǝ tya Ikoniya.
Milkushtiwas njikǝn nǝ hwol tugi nǝ Yal ki batl ki Lya.
